description: This Go source file defines a package 'interactors' that implements a TaskRunner struct for executing functions asynchronously, handling concurrency, synchronization, and error propagation via channels.

classes.name: taskRunner
classes.description: A struct for managing concurrent execution of tasks with error handling, synchronization, and communication via channels.

methods.name: ExecuteFunctionsAsync
methods.description: Runs a list of functions asynchronously, returning an error if any function produces an error.

methods.name: breakOnError
methods.description: Blocks until an error is received on the error channel.

methods.name: syncErrorFnToAsync
methods.description: Converts a list of functions with error return to functions that redirect errors to a channel.

methods.name: closeErrorChanOnComplete
methods.description: Closes the error channel after all spawned tasks have completed.

methods.name: spawnTasksAsync
methods.description: Starts all provided functions as goroutines and manages synchronization.

methods.name: redirectErrToChannel
methods.description: Wraps a function to send its error (if any) to the error channel.
